en-US.description: Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.
en-US.longDescription: Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
en-US.name: Lexora Buddy
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release focuses on split-pane performance in complex tasks, task cleanup, and making local models more useful.
Split-pane dragging time in complex states has dropped from 8 seconds to 1 second, making multi-pane workflows smoother. New task archiving and permanent cleanup let you put temporary tasks aside and remove their data when no longer needed, preventing leftovers from accumulating on disk. We’ve also refined support for less-capable local models to make tool calling easier, alongside better local image-to-image workflows, including reference-image handling and saving generated results.
The image viewer now supports zooming, rotation, copying, and referencing, while Chinese input users can access commands and Skills directly. This release also improves local inference diagnostics, cloud backup, MCP settings, and the macOS menu bar icon.

zh-CN.description: 具备插件、内置浏览器、工作区文件与本地模型支持的桌面 AI Agent。
zh-CN.longDescription: Lexora 是在真实桌面实践中自我演化的个人 AI Agent。它不局限于代码助手的角色，也能陪你整理资料、打磨作品、安排日常。你说出目标，它持续推进，让文字成为工作、创作与生活的起点。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
这个版本，我们重点打磨了 复杂任务下的分屏体验、任务清理，以及本地模型的实用性。
复杂状态下的分屏拖动耗时从 8 秒降低到 1 秒，多面板操作更加流畅；新增 任务归档与永久清理，让临时任务可以先收起、再按需清理，避免任务残留长期占据硬盘。我们也针对能力较弱的本地模型完善了适配，让工具调用更顺畅，并改善了 本地图生图 的参考图传递与结果保存体验。
此外，图片查看器支持缩放、旋转、复制与引用，中文输入法可以直接唤起命令和技能。本地推理诊断、云备份、MCP 设置和 macOS 菜单栏图标等细节也得到完善。
